calls.reason: An independent Fediverse Report audit found the report's main source, a TwipeMobile article, mediocre and factually flawed, and found one Reddit post cited six times. Some citations were sound, but the overall source base looks weak.

Every year pair with data shows burn rising: Anthropic's S-1 shows 2023 to 2024 up sharply, and OpenAI's losses doubled in 2022 and reached about $5B in 2024. There are gaps (OpenAI 2023, Anthropic 2021–22), but nothing shows a decline.
This is a rhetorical, first-person claim with no threshold for 'real money' and no defined set of apps. CNBC's figure of $3.7B revenue against a $5B loss can be read either way.

OpenAI lost about $5B in 2024. Anthropic's S-1 shows its net loss rising from $1.5B to $8.3B and its operating loss widening, so neither company was profitable. Compute cost as a share of revenue did improve.

The one independent audit is mixed. It found weak sources, factual errors and missing sources, but also credits the report with getting much right and finding relevant, even obscure, information, which cuts against 'at all'.
